sources.summary: Technology company Meta has released its first in-house-designed AI smart glasses, which the company has touted as more affordable and ergonomic than its previous versions. The Meta Glasses line encompasses three style types – Meta Adventurer, Meta Fury and Meta Glasses, the latter designed with influencer Kylie Jenner.
